title: CMM Postdoctoral Visiting Program 2026-2027
institution: Center for Mathematical Modeling (CMM), Universidad de Chile
about: Universidad de Chile's Center for Mathematical Modeling invites postdoctoral researchers to apply for short research visits to Santiago, with flexible start dates between May and September 2027. Applications close on 18 December 2026.

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations II
why: "Mathematical modeling and applied mathematics" → "Analyze time-dependent data using time-series approaches such as ARIMA, state-space models, and spectral methods."
"Mathematical modeling" → "Use survival analysis and reliability modelling to study time-to-event outcomes, duration, failure, and risk over time."
